categories.path: 血液腫瘤科 > 抗癌 > Platinum compounds

items.text: Carboplatin：Platinum藥物：形成DNA cross-link → 阻止DNA複製與轉錄。
用於：卵巢癌、睪丸癌、肺癌、膀胱癌、結直腸癌等依藥物不同。
考點：鉑類＝DNA cross-link；cisplatin腎耳毒性最典型，carboplatin骨髓抑制較多，oxaliplatin冷誘發神經毒性。
常考/禁忌：腎毒性、耳毒性、周邊神經病變、嚴重嘔吐、骨髓抑制；cisplatin可低鎂。

statements.text: Aquated carboplatin forms predominantly interstrand DNA cross-links, disrupting DNA replication and transcription; the effect is cell-cycle nonspecific.
Carboplatin and cisplatin produce similar drug-DNA lesions, while their potency difference tracks the slower aquation of carboplatin.
Produces antitumor activity in advanced ovarian carcinoma in combination or as palliative retreatment.
Initial combination treatment of advanced ovarian carcinoma and palliative treatment of recurrent ovarian carcinoma after prior chemotherapy.
Myelosuppression, especially thrombocytopenia, neutropenia and anemia, and nausea/vomiting are frequent.
Severe marrow suppression with infection or bleeding and immediate anaphylactic-like reactions can be life-threatening.
The boxed warning requires experienced oncology supervision and highlights severe marrow suppression, vomiting and anaphylactic-like reactions.
Contraindicated after severe platinum hypersensitivity and in severe marrow depression or significant bleeding.
Dose-limiting marrow suppression is greater with renal impairment or prior therapy; audiologic and neurologic toxicity also require attention.
After a 30-minute infusion in patients with creatinine clearance about 60 mL/min or greater, intact carboplatin has an alpha half-life of 1.1-2 hours and beta half-life of 2.6-5.9 hours.
Renal excretion is the major route; about 65% of a dose is recovered in urine within 12 hours and 71% within 24 hours when renal function is adequate.
Carboplatin itself is initially unbound, while platinum subsequently becomes irreversibly protein-bound and is eliminated slowly.
Concomitant nephrotoxic compounds, including aminoglycosides, can potentiate renal or audiologic toxicity.
Monitor CBC until recovery, renal function, electrolytes, hearing when clinically indicated, and hypersensitivity during infusion.
Carboplatin can cause fetal harm; historical labeling classifies use in pregnancy as category D.
Breastfeeding should be discontinued during carboplatin treatment because serious infant toxicity is possible.
Safety and effectiveness in pediatric patients have not been established, and pediatric audiologic toxicity has been reported.
Older adults were more likely to develop severe thrombocytopenia; renal function should guide dose selection.
There is no known antidote; expected complications reflect marrow suppression and hepatic toxicity.
Compared with cisplatin, carboplatin is classically associated with more dose-limiting marrow suppression, while renal clearance remains central to dosing.

categories.path: 神經/精神科 > 交感神經阻斷劑 > α1+β阻斷

items.text: Carvedilol：阻α1 → 血管/前列腺/膀胱頸平滑肌放鬆。
用於：BPH、高血壓、尿路症狀。
考點：α+β blocker；labetalol常考孕婦高血壓。
常考/禁忌：first-dose syncope、姿勢性低血壓、反射性心搏快、射精障礙；白內障術中虹膜鬆弛。

mnemonics.text: p.52: 我也(meto-)鼻屎(biso-)卡血管(carve-)那邊(nebi-) 卡血管=car-vessel，簡稱carve!阿 卡血管就心衰竭了!
p.52: 眉頭(Meto-)那邊(Nebi-) 一堆閉鎖(Biso-)粉刺，別再喝咖啡(Carve-)了！
p.52: 卡文(carve)內壁(nebi-)必收(biso-)metal(meto-) 翻譯：卡文迪許向內壁咚，且一定會收藏 metal金屬類型的唱片
p.14: 來逼他(Labeta-)熬夜喝咖啡打lol(Carve-dilol)

statements.text: The S(-) enantiomer blocks beta receptors, while both enantiomers block alpha1 receptors; carvedilol has no intrinsic sympathomimetic activity.
Beta blockade lowers heart rate and renin activity, while alpha1 blockade reduces vascular resistance and blood pressure.
Improves survival and reduces hospitalization in selected chronic heart failure and reduces cardiovascular mortality after MI with left-ventricular dysfunction.
Mild-to-severe chronic heart failure, clinically stable left-ventricular dysfunction after MI, and essential hypertension.
Dizziness, fatigue, hypotension, diarrhea, hyperglycemia, bradycardia and weight increase are common in heart-failure/post-MI populations.
Severe bradycardia, heart block, decompensated heart failure, bronchospasm and serious hypersensitivity can occur.

Contraindicated in bronchial asthma/bronchospasm, advanced AV block or sick sinus without pacing, severe bradycardia, cardiogenic shock/decompensated failure requiring IV inotropes, severe hepatic impairment and serious hypersensitivity.
Initiate and titrate carefully because hypotension, bradycardia, worsening heart failure and masking of hypoglycemia can occur; do not stop abruptly.
The apparent mean terminal elimination half-life is generally 7-10 hours.
Carvedilol is extensively metabolized, including CYP2D6- and CYP2C9-dependent pathways; less than 2% is excreted unchanged in urine.
Oral carvedilol is rapidly and extensively absorbed, but first-pass metabolism limits absolute bioavailability to about 25%-35%.
CYP2D6 inhibitors, rifampin, digoxin, cyclosporine, clonidine, amiodarone, verapamil/diltiazem and glucose-lowering drugs can produce important interactions.
Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, weight/fluid status, heart-failure symptoms, glucose in diabetes and conduction when combined with nodal blockers.
Human pregnancy data are insufficient; third-trimester beta blockade can cause neonatal hypotension, bradycardia, hypoglycemia and respiratory depression.
Human-milk data are unavailable; weigh breastfeeding benefits against maternal need and potential infant effects.
Contraindicated in severe hepatic impairment because exposure can rise substantially.
Effectiveness has not been established in patients younger than 18 years.
Overdose may cause severe hypotension, bradycardia, heart failure, cardiogenic shock, bronchospasm, vomiting, altered consciousness and seizures; treatment is supportive.
Carvedilol uniquely combines nonselective beta blockade with alpha1 blockade and is one of the beta blockers with outcome evidence in systolic heart failure.

categories.path: 感染科 > 抗黴菌 > Echinocandin

items.text: Caspofungin：抑制β-1,3-D-glucan synthase → 真菌細胞壁合成下降。
用於：侵襲性Candida、Aspergillus救援/合併。
考點：-fungin打真菌細胞壁，人體沒有glucan所以毒性低。
常考/禁忌：肝酵素上升、組織胺樣輸注反應；Cryptococcus無效。

statements.text: Inhibits beta-(1,3)-D-glucan synthase, reducing an essential fungal cell-wall polymer absent from mammalian cells.
Displays concentration-dependent activity against Candida and inhibits growth of Aspergillus hyphal tips and branch points.
Treats invasive candidiasis and esophageal candidiasis, serves as salvage therapy for invasive aspergillosis, and is used empirically in febrile neutropenia.
Empiric therapy in febrile neutropenia, candidemia/invasive candidiasis, esophageal candidiasis and refractory or intolerant invasive aspergillosis.
Fever, diarrhea, elevated hepatic enzymes, hypokalemia and infusion-related reactions are common.
Anaphylaxis, histamine-mediated infusion reactions, severe skin reactions and clinically important hepatic injury can occur.
Contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to any component.
Monitor for anaphylaxis, histamine-mediated reactions, severe cutaneous reactions and hepatic laboratory abnormalities.
Plasma decline is multiphasic, with a beta half-life about 9-11 hours and a terminal gamma phase about 40-50 hours.
Caspofungin is slowly metabolized by hydrolysis and N-acetylation rather than CYP-mediated biotransformation.
Distribution dominates early clearance; drug-related material is ultimately recovered in both urine and feces.
Cyclosporine can increase hepatic laboratory abnormalities; rifampin and other enzyme inducers may reduce caspofungin exposure, while caspofungin lowers tacrolimus concentrations.
Monitor clinical/mycologic response, liver tests, infusion reactions and tacrolimus concentration when coadministered.
Human pregnancy data are insufficient; animal data show placental transfer and developmental toxicity at relevant exposures.
Human milk data are unavailable; weigh breastfeeding benefits against maternal need and potential infant effects.
Reduce the adult maintenance dose in moderate hepatic impairment; clinical experience in severe impairment is lacking.
Safety and effectiveness are established from 3 months through 17 years for specified indications; data below 3 months are limited.
Caspofungin is not dialyzable; reported high cumulative exposures were managed with observation and supportive care.
Echinocandin equals fungal cell-wall beta-glucan inhibition; unlike azoles it does not inhibit ergosterol synthesis.

items.text: Cefepime：是第四代cephalosporin；結合PBP抑制細胞壁，廣效G−含Pseudomonas且保留較好G+。
用於：院內肺炎、敗血症、發燒性中性球低下、Pseudomonas感染。
考點：世代越後Gram−通常越強；ceftazidime/cefepime打Pseudomonas，ceftaroline打MRSA。
常考/禁忌：過敏、神經毒性/癲癇（腎功能差）、C. difficile。

mnemonics.text: p.106: 是(4)誰放屁(cefepime)!屁臭到我的腦裡(進BBB，有中樞作用)

statements.text: Binds bacterial penicillin-binding proteins and inhibits cell-wall synthesis, leading to cell lysis.
As with other beta-lactams, efficacy correlates with the time unbound cefepime concentration remains above the organism MIC.
Treats susceptible pneumonia, febrile neutropenia, urinary tract, skin/skin-structure and complicated intra-abdominal infections.
Pneumonia, empiric treatment of febrile neutropenia, urinary tract infection, uncomplicated skin/skin-structure infection and complicated intra-abdominal infection with metronidazole.
Local injection reactions, rash, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting and positive Coombs test are reported reactions.
Neurotoxicity including encephalopathy, myoclonus, seizures and nonconvulsive status epilepticus can occur, especially with unadjusted renal dosing.
Contraindicated after immediate hypersensitivity to cefepime, cephalosporins, penicillins or other beta-lactams.
Adjust for renal impairment and evaluate neurologic change, severe hypersensitivity and Clostridioides difficile-associated diarrhea.
Mean elimination half-life in healthy adults is approximately 2 hours.
Elimination is principally renal; most administered drug is recovered unchanged in urine and clearance falls with creatinine clearance.
Cefepime can cross an inflamed blood-brain barrier.
Aminoglycosides and potent diuretics can add nephrotoxicity; monitor renal function during relevant combinations.
Monitor renal function, mental status/seizure activity, cultures and clinical response; use susceptibility data when available.
Human beta-lactam pregnancy data have not established a drug-associated major-malformation or miscarriage risk.
Cefepime is present in human milk at low concentrations; monitor the infant as clinically appropriate.
Dose adjustment is required when creatinine clearance is 60 mL/min or less because half-life is markedly prolonged.
Safety and effectiveness are established from 2 months of age for specified infections; dosing depends on age, weight and renal function.
Overdose, especially with renal impairment, can produce encephalopathy, seizures and neuromuscular excitability; hemodialysis removes cefepime.
Fourth-generation cephalosporin with Pseudomonas coverage; renal accumulation is the classic setting for cefepime neurotoxicity.

categories.path: 感染科 > 抗生素 > Cephalosporin第三代

items.text: Ceftazidime：是第三代cephalosporin；結合PBP抑制細胞壁，G−與CNS穿透較佳；ceftriaxone/cefotaxime打腦膜炎，ceftazidime打Pseudomonas。
用於：嚴重G−感染、腦膜炎、淋病、院內感染（依藥物）。
考點：世代越後Gram−通常越強；ceftazidime/cefepime打Pseudomonas，ceftaroline打MRSA。
常考/禁忌：過敏、膽泥/膽道沉積（ceftriaxone）、C. difficile；ceftazidime對G+較弱。

statements.text: Inhibits bacterial cell-wall synthesis by binding penicillin-binding proteins and is stable to selected beta-lactamases.
Bactericidal activity depends on beta-lactam exposure relative to the organism MIC.
Treats susceptible lower respiratory, skin, urinary, bloodstream, bone/joint, gynecologic, intra-abdominal and central-nervous-system infections.
Treatment of susceptible serious infections, including Pseudomonas infections and bacterial meningitis; may be used alone in selected proven or strongly suspected sepsis.
Local reactions, hypersensitivity manifestations, gastrointestinal symptoms and transient hepatic laboratory abnormalities are reported.
Anaphylaxis, severe cutaneous reactions, Clostridioides difficile-associated diarrhea and neurologic toxicity/seizures can occur.
Contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to ceftazidime or cephalosporins.
Evaluate beta-lactam allergy, adjust renal dosing and stop for severe hypersensitivity or significant neurotoxicity.
The elimination half-life is about 1.9 hours after IV administration and about 2 hours after IM administration in healthy adults.
Approximately 80%-90% of an IM or IV dose is excreted unchanged by the kidneys within 24 hours.
Protein binding is less than 10%, and therapeutic concentrations reach many tissues and CSF when meninges are inflamed.
High-dose cephalosporins with nephrotoxic drugs such as aminoglycosides or potent diuretics may adversely affect renal function.
Monitor renal function, neurologic status, cultures and treatment response; prolonged therapy may require blood-count and organ-function surveillance.
Animal studies did not show impaired fertility or fetal harm, but adequate controlled pregnancy studies are unavailable.
Ceftazidime is excreted in human milk at low concentrations; use caution during nursing.
Reduce dosage when renal function is impaired because ceftazidime is almost entirely cleared by glomerular filtration.
Pediatric dosing is provided from the neonatal period through childhood, with higher meningitis dosing and renal adjustment when needed.
Overdose, especially in renal failure, may cause seizures, encephalopathy and neuromuscular excitability; dialysis can reduce serum concentrations.
Ceftazidime is the classic third-generation cephalosporin with Pseudomonas activity; it is not interchangeable with ceftazidime-avibactam for resistant carbapenemase producers.

categories.path: 風濕免疫科 > NSAID > COX-2選擇性

items.text: Celecoxib：抑制COX-1/2 → prostaglandin與thromboxane下降。
用於：疼痛、發燒、發炎；aspirin低劑量抗血小板。
考點：COX-1保胃/腎/血小板，COX-2發炎/痛。
常考/禁忌：胃潰瘍出血、腎傷害、水腫/高血壓、支氣管痙攣、心血管風險；aspirin有Reye syndrome。

statements.text: Inhibits prostaglandin synthesis primarily through COX-2 inhibition at therapeutic concentrations; selectivity is dose dependent and not absolute.
Reduced prostaglandin formation provides analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects while also contributing to cardiovascular, renal and gastrointestinal risks.
Relieves signs and symptoms of arthritis, acute pain and primary dysmenorrhea.
Osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, juvenile rheumatoid arthritis in patients 2 years and older, ankylosing spondylitis, acute pain and primary dysmenorrhea.
Abdominal pain, diarrhea, dyspepsia, flatulence, edema, dizziness, pharyngitis and upper respiratory infection are common.
Potentially fatal cardiovascular thrombotic events, gastrointestinal bleeding/perforation, renal injury, hepatotoxicity and severe skin or hypersensitivity reactions can occur.
Boxed warnings describe increased cardiovascular thrombotic risk and serious gastrointestinal bleeding, ulceration and perforation; celecoxib is contraindicated around CABG surgery.
Contraindicated after celecoxib or sulfonamide hypersensitivity, aspirin/NSAID-associated asthma or allergic reactions, and in the CABG setting.
Use the lowest effective dose for the shortest duration and monitor for cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, hepatic, renal, hematologic and hypersensitivity toxicity.
The effective half-life is approximately 11 hours.
Celecoxib is metabolized primarily by CYP2C9 and is highly protein bound.
Peak plasma concentrations occur about 3 hours after an oral dose; a high-fat meal delays the peak by 1-2 hours and increases exposure modestly.
Anticoagulants/antiplatelets, SSRIs/SNRIs, ACE inhibitors/ARBs, diuretics, lithium, methotrexate, cyclosporine, CYP2C9 modifiers and other NSAIDs have important interactions.
Monitor blood pressure, edema/heart failure, renal and hepatic function, blood counts during long-term use and signs of gastrointestinal bleeding.
Avoid use at about 30 weeks gestation and later; limit exposure at about 20-30 weeks because of fetal renal dysfunction and oligohydramnios risk.
Low celecoxib concentrations occur in human milk; weigh breastfeeding benefits against maternal need and infant risk.
Reduce dose in moderate hepatic impairment and avoid severe hepatic impairment.
Safety and effectiveness are established for juvenile rheumatoid arthritis from age 2 years; long-term cardiovascular toxicity in children has not been fully evaluated.
NSAID overdose is managed supportively; severe poisoning may include gastrointestinal bleeding, hypertension, renal failure, respiratory depression or coma.
Celecoxib is relatively COX-2 selective, not COX-2 exclusive; cardiovascular and renal risks remain despite less platelet COX-1 inhibition.

categories.path: 自泌素 > Histamine > 第二代H1阻斷

items.text: Cetirizine：第二代H1 inverse agonist：阻H1過敏訊號，較不進CNS。
用於：過敏性鼻炎、蕁麻疹。
考點：第二代較不嗜睡、抗膽鹼少。
常考/禁忌：頭痛、口乾；少數嗜睡（cetirizine較可能）。

mnemonics.text: p.58: “他叮，那叮，離心”：他被叮(-tadine)，那裡被叮(-nadine)，抽個血離心(-rizine)看有沒有瘧原蟲感 染

statements.text: Cetirizine competitively antagonizes peripheral histamine H1 receptors and has relatively limited central anticholinergic activity.
Suppresses histamine-mediated wheal-and-flare responses for about 24 hours after usual oral dosing.
Relieves sneezing, rhinorrhea, itchy nose/throat and itchy watery eyes from indoor and outdoor allergies.
Temporary relief of indoor and outdoor allergy symptoms; the archived prescription label also supports perennial/seasonal allergic rhinitis and chronic idiopathic urticaria.
Somnolence, fatigue and dry mouth are among common dose-related reactions.
Hypersensitivity, including anaphylaxis, has been reported; excessive sedation can impair driving or machinery operation.
Do not use after allergy to cetirizine or hydroxyzine.
Drowsiness may occur; avoid alcohol and use caution with driving, sedatives, renal disease or hepatic disease.
Mean elimination half-life in healthy adults is about 8 hours and is prolonged by age or renal dysfunction.
A substantial fraction is excreted unchanged in urine, making renal function important for clearance.
Peak plasma concentration occurs about 1 hour after oral administration; food delays the peak without reducing total exposure.
Alcohol, tranquilizers and sedatives can increase drowsiness; no broad CYP interaction claim is made from the OTC label.
Monitor symptom response, sedation and dosing appropriateness when renal/hepatic disease or older age is present.
If pregnant, seek health-professional advice before use because the OTC label does not provide individualized risk assessment.
If breastfeeding, seek health-professional advice; cetirizine can be present in human milk.
Clearance is reduced and half-life prolonged in renal impairment; dose selection must follow product-specific directions.
Prescription-era evidence established age- and formulation-specific pediatric dosing; the current tablet Drug Facts directs children under 6 years to a physician.
Overdose commonly causes marked somnolence in adults and agitation/restlessness followed by drowsiness in children; treatment is supportive.
Cetirizine is a second-generation H1 antihistamine with less, not zero, sedation; it is not the H1 drug used to treat antipsychotic extrapyramidal symptoms.

items.text: Chlordiazepoxide：正向變構調節GABA_A → 增加Cl−通道開啟頻率 → 神經抑制增加。
用於：焦慮、失眠、癲癇重積、酒精戒斷、肌肉痙攣、麻醉前給藥。
考點：BZD增加frequency；解毒flumazenil但小心癲癇。
常考/禁忌：嗜睡、共濟失調、記憶障礙、呼吸抑制（合併酒精/opioid）、依賴；flumazenil可逆轉但可能誘發癲癇。

statements.text: Chlordiazepoxide is a benzodiazepine that acts at GABA-A sites; the selected label does not define a more exact receptor-level mechanism.
Produces anxiolytic, sedative, anticonvulsant and muscle-relaxant CNS effects with dose-dependent respiratory/CNS depression when combined with opioids.
Provides short-term relief of anxiety, controls acute alcohol-withdrawal symptoms and reduces preoperative apprehension.
Management of anxiety disorders or short-term relief of anxiety symptoms, withdrawal symptoms of acute alcoholism and preoperative apprehension/anxiety.
Drowsiness, ataxia, confusion, dizziness and impaired coordination are common benzodiazepine effects.
Concomitant opioid use can cause profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma and death; misuse, addiction, dependence and dangerous withdrawal can occur.
Boxed warnings cover opioid co-use, abuse/misuse/addiction and physical dependence with withdrawal reactions.
Contraindicated in patients with hypersensitivity to chlordiazepoxide.
Use the lowest effective dose, avoid abrupt discontinuation after continued use and assess abuse/addiction and respiratory-depression risk.
Peak blood concentrations require several hours after oral administration.
Parent-drug half-life is about 24-48 hours, and active metabolites prolong clinical effects after discontinuation.
Chlordiazepoxide and metabolites are excreted in urine; only a small fraction is unchanged parent drug.
Opioids, alcohol and other CNS depressants add sedation and respiratory depression; CYP-modifying drugs may alter benzodiazepine exposure.
Monitor sedation, respiratory status, falls, misuse/dependence and withdrawal during a gradual taper.
Benzodiazepine exposure can cause fetal/neonatal harm, including neonatal sedation or withdrawal; use only after risk-benefit assessment.
Because infant sedation and other serious reactions are possible, breastfeeding decisions require weighing maternal need and infant risk.
Safety and effectiveness below 6 years have not been established; pediatric dosing above that age remains indication specific.
Use smaller doses in older or debilitated patients to reduce ataxia, oversedation and confusion.
Overdose causes CNS depression ranging from drowsiness to coma; manage airway/supportively, and reserve flumazenil for carefully selected cases because it can precipitate seizures.
Chlordiazepoxide is long acting because of its parent half-life and active metabolites; alcohol-withdrawal use does not make it a short-onset hypnotic.

items.text: Cisplatin：Platinum藥物：形成DNA cross-link → 阻止DNA複製與轉錄。
用於：卵巢癌、睪丸癌、肺癌、膀胱癌、結直腸癌等依藥物不同。
考點：鉑類＝DNA cross-link；cisplatin腎耳毒性最典型，carboplatin骨髓抑制較多，oxaliplatin冷誘發神經毒性。
常考/禁忌：腎毒性、耳毒性、周邊神經病變、嚴重嘔吐、骨髓抑制；cisplatin可低鎂。

statements.text: Aquated platinum species bind DNA, forming intra- and interstrand cross-links that inhibit DNA replication and transcription and promote cell death.
Cisplatin cytotoxicity is cell-cycle nonspecific and also involves DNA-damage responses rather than microtubule binding.
Produces antitumor activity in metastatic testicular and ovarian tumors and advanced bladder cancer within labeled regimens.
Combination therapy for metastatic testicular tumors, metastatic ovarian tumors and advanced bladder cancer, with selected single-agent use in previously treated ovarian cancer.
Nausea/vomiting, nephrotoxicity, electrolyte wasting, myelosuppression and ototoxicity are frequent clinically important toxicities.
Dose-related cumulative renal failure, severe ototoxicity, neuropathy, anaphylaxis and marrow suppression can be life-threatening or irreversible.
Boxed warnings require experienced oncology supervision and emphasize cumulative nephrotoxicity, severe nausea/vomiting and dose-related myelosuppression.
Contraindicated in pre-existing renal impairment, myelosuppression, hearing impairment or prior severe platinum hypersensitivity.
Provide hydration and monitor renal function/electrolytes; cumulative ototoxicity and peripheral neuropathy may be irreversible.
Cisplatin is activated mainly by nonenzymatic displacement of chloride by nucleophiles rather than conventional enzyme metabolism.
Renal excretion is the major route; a mean of roughly 35%-51% of administered platinum is recovered in urine over five days in studied regimens.
Platinum derived from cisplatin becomes extensively and irreversibly bound to plasma proteins; bound platinum has a terminal persistence of at least several days.
Aminoglycosides, loop diuretics and other nephrotoxic/ototoxic drugs can increase renal or auditory toxicity.
Monitor creatinine clearance, magnesium/potassium/calcium, CBC, hearing and neurologic toxicity before and during treatment.
Cisplatin can cause fetal harm based on mechanism and animal/human experience.
Cisplatin is present in human milk; breastfeeding is not recommended during treatment.
Pre-existing renal impairment is a contraindication because nephrotoxicity is cumulative and dose limiting.
Pediatric safety/effectiveness are not established for labeled indications, and ototoxicity is especially important in children.
Overdose can cause severe renal, hepatic, neurologic, hematologic and auditory toxicity; no proven antidote reliably reverses established toxicity.
Cisplatin is the platinum drug classically associated with the strongest nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity; it is not a spindle poison.

categories.path: 心臟科 > 利尿劑 > ADH拮抗

items.text: Conivaptan：拮抗vasopressin受器（多V2，conivaptan也V1a）→ collecting duct aquaporin-2插入下降 → free water排出↑。
用於：SIADH、心衰/肝硬化相關低鈉（依藥物）。
考點：vaptan＝ADH拮抗，治SIADH低鈉。
常考/禁忌：口渴、多尿、低血壓、矯正低鈉過快造成滲透性脫髓鞘；tolvaptan肝毒性。

Fulminant hepatitis/hepatic failure, optic neuritis, peripheral neuropathy and psychotic reactions can occur.
Never administer to an intoxicated patient or without the patient's full knowledge.
Contraindicated with recent alcohol, metronidazole or paraldehyde, and in severe myocardial disease/coronary occlusion, psychosis or thiuram hypersensitivity.
Patients must avoid hidden alcohol for up to 14 days after treatment; severe disulfiram-alcohol reactions require emergency care.
Disulfiram is slowly absorbed from the gastrointestinal tract.
Alcohol sensitivity may persist for 1-2 weeks after the last dose because drug effects are eliminated slowly.
Disulfiram and sulfur-containing metabolites inhibit multiple metabolic pathways and can raise concentrations of interacting drugs.
Disulfiram can increase phenytoin and oral-anticoagulant effects; isoniazid can add gait or mental-status toxicity, and metronidazole is contraindicated.
Verify abstinence/informed consent and monitor liver tests, neuropathy/vision, mental status and interacting drug concentrations or coagulation.
Safety in pregnancy is not established; use only when probable benefit outweighs risk.
The selected label advises that disulfiram should not be given to nursing mothers.
Hepatic disease increases concern because severe and sometimes fatal hepatitis can occur even without prior liver abnormality.
Safety and effectiveness in pediatric patients have not been established.
No specific antidote is established; contact a poison center and provide supportive management.
Disulfiram blocks aldehyde dehydrogenase, so alcohol causes acetaldehyde-mediated flushing, vomiting and hypotension; the effect can persist after stopping.

items.text: Dofetilide：以阻K+通道為主 → phase 3 repolarization延長、有效不反應期↑、QT延長。
用於：AF/Flutter、VT等依藥物。
考點：純K blocker最怕torsades。
常考/禁忌：QT延長/torsades（amiodarone例外較少）；amiodarone肺/肝/甲狀腺/角膜/皮膚毒性。

statements.text: Blocks cardiac IKr, delaying repolarization without clinically relevant sodium-channel, alpha- or beta-receptor blockade.
Prolongs atrial and ventricular action-potential duration/refractoriness and QT interval in a concentration-dependent manner.
Converts atrial fibrillation/flutter and delays recurrence after restoration of sinus rhythm in highly symptomatic patients.
Maintenance of sinus rhythm after conversion of atrial fibrillation/flutter lasting more than one week and pharmacologic conversion of atrial fibrillation/flutter.
Headache, chest pain and dizziness are among the most frequent nonarrhythmic adverse events.
Dose- and concentration-related QT prolongation can cause torsades de pointes and other life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias.
Initiation or re-initiation requires at least three days in a facility able to calculate creatinine clearance, continuously monitor ECG and provide cardiac resuscitation.
Contraindicated with long-QT syndromes, excessive baseline QT/QTc, creatinine clearance below 20 mL/min, hypersensitivity and specified inhibitors of renal cation transport or hydrochlorothiazide.
Select dose by creatinine clearance and QT response; stop or reduce for excessive QT prolongation and correct potassium/magnesium abnormalities.
Terminal half-life is approximately 10 hours and steady state is reached in 2-3 days.
About 80% of a dose is excreted in urine, mostly unchanged through filtration and active cation transport.
Oral bioavailability exceeds 90%, with peak plasma concentration about 2-3 hours after fasting administration.
Verapamil, cimetidine, trimethoprim, ketoconazole, hydrochlorothiazide and several renal-cation-transport inhibitors are contraindicated because they increase exposure/QT risk.
Measure creatinine clearance, baseline and post-dose QTc, potassium/magnesium and continuous rhythm during initiation; reassess renal function and QT at follow-up.
Adequate controlled pregnancy studies are unavailable; use only when benefit justifies fetal risk.
Milk data are unavailable; patients are advised not to breastfeed while taking dofetilide.
Dose is determined by creatinine clearance and dofetilide is contraindicated below 20 mL/min because renal clearance governs exposure.
Safety and effectiveness below age 18 have not been established.
Overdose chiefly produces excessive QT prolongation/torsades; use continuous monitoring, magnesium, pacing or isoproterenol as clinically indicated.
Dofetilide is a pure IKr blocker with no sodium-channel effect; monitored three-day initiation and renal dose calculation are signature exam points.
